text: So they have [[Nufayl ibn Habib al-Khuth'ami|Nufayl al-Khuth'ami]] and they have [[Dhu Nafar|Dhu Nafar]] as
two prisoners on their way.
So they continue on their way.
Now, they finally reach [[al-Ta'if|Ta'if]].
So they're very close to [[Makkah|Makkah]] now, [[al-Ta'if|Ta'if]] is not far from [[Makkah|Makkah]].
Now when they reach [[al-Ta'if|Ta'if]],
the sad thing is
that the people of [[al-Ta'if|Ta'if]], they showed a very
cowardly attitude, compared to [[Dhu Nafar|Dhu Nafar]] and [[Nufayl ibn Habib al-Khuth'ami|Nufayl al-Khuth'ami]].
The people of [[al-Ta'if|Ta'if]], the tribe of [[Thaqif|Thaqif]],
they showed a very cowardly response to [[Abrahah|Abrahah]].
They were afraid for themselves, they didn't want [[Abrahah|Abrahah]] to destroy their city and kill their people.
So they said, 'Okay, you want to go to [[Makkah|Makkah]] and destroy [[Makkah|Makkah]]? We're not going to stand in your way. You go right ahead
and do that.'
And the extent of their treason
was so much
that they actually offered [[Abrahah|Abrahah]],
they said, 'We'll even send one of our people to go with you
to show you how to get to [[Makkah|Makkah]], to show you [[Makkah|Makkah]] from here.'
So there was a man named [[Abu Righal|Abu Righal]].
[[Abu Righal|Abu Righal]], he actually volunteered, he said, 'Yeah, I'll go with them, I'll show them [[Makkah|Makkah]], no problem.'
So this was a huge treachery and betrayal
that these people showed and specifically [[Abu Righal|Abu Righal]].
So [[Abu Righal|Abu Righal]], he accompanies the army of [[Abrahah|Abrahah]],
and they're going from [[al-Ta'if|Ta'if]] towards [[Makkah|Makkah]], and [[Abu Righal|Abu Righal]] is actually showing them the way, how to get to [[Makkah|Makkah]].
He really guides them as he said he would.
And just before they reach [[Makkah|Makkah]], they're close to [[Makkah|Makkah]],
[[Abu Righal|Abu Righal]], he dies, Allah [[Subhanahu wa Ta'ala|سبحانه وتعالى]] caused him to die, and he is buried there.
[[Abu Righal|Abu Righal]] is buried on the way from [[al-Ta'if|Ta'if]] to [[Makkah|Makkah]], and later on in
the years that came,
the place where [[Abu Righal|Abu Righal]] was buried, his grave, it became a place where the Arabs would come to stone.
They would come to the grave of [[Abu Righal|Abu Righal]] and they would stone that grave,

because of this man's betrayal and his treachery that he helped the enemies of Allah [[Subhanahu wa Ta'ala|سبحانه وتعالى]] try to come and destroy the house of Allah [[Subhanahu wa Ta'ala|سبحانه وتعالى]]. So it became a place where the Arabs would come and stone.
So finally,
[[Abrahah|Abrahah]], he reaches the outskirts of [[Makkah|Makkah]] with his big army, and on the outskirts of [[Makkah|Makkah]],
there are people grazing their camels.
There are people that are grazing their camels.
And [[Abrahah|Abrahah]] and his army, they seize all of those camels, they take all of those camels, and included in those camels
were 200 camels of [[Abdul Muttalib|عبد المطلب]],
200 camels of [[Abdul Muttalib|عبد المطلب]], and you know who [[Abdul Muttalib|عبد المطلب]] is, he is the grandfather of [[Rasulullah|رسول الله]] ﷺ.
So 200 camels of [[Abdul Muttalib|عبد المطلب]] and other camels for the other people of [[Makkah|Makkah]], [[Abrahah|Abrahah]] and his army, they confiscate all of them and they take them.
And they come into [[Makkah|Makkah]].
So [[Abdul Muttalib|عبد المطلب]], he sees what's happening, he sees this [[Habashi|حبشي]] man with a huge army, he has come into [[Makkah|Makkah]],
and he wants to have a face-to-face meeting with [[Abrahah|Abrahah]].
So he tries to arrange a meeting. He said, 'I am the leader of the people of [[Makkah|Makkah]],' and [[Abdul Muttalib|عبد المطلب]], he was the leader of [[Makkah|Makkah]] without any question.

I mean nobody even would think of coming towards his place in authority. [[Abdul Muttalib|عبد المطلب]] was without question the leader of [[Makkah|Makkah]] and everyone of [[Makkah|Makkah]], they respected him as their leader.
So as the leader of [[Makkah|Makkah]], [[Abdul Muttalib|عبد المطلب]] requested a face-to-face meeting with
the commander of this army that had come in, [[Abrahah|Abrahah]].
But [[Abrahah|Abrahah]], he refused to meet anyone. [[Abrahah|Abrahah]] said, 'No, I'm not interested to meet anyone.
I'm going to do what I came to do here,
destroy the [[Ka'bah|كعبة]].'
So he refuses this meeting, and [[Abdul Muttalib|عبد المطلب]], he doesn't know what to do.
He really wants to talk to him.
So he goes to [[Dhu Nafar|Dhu Nafar]]. [[Dhu Nafar|Dhu Nafar]], as we mentioned,
he was the first prisoner that [[Abrahah|Abrahah]] had taken on his way from [[Yemen|اليمن]] to [[Makkah|Makkah]].
So he's still there with the army and he's still imprisoned. So [[Abdul Muttalib|عبد المطلب]], he goes to [[Dhu Nafar|Dhu Nafar]]
and he says to [[Dhu Nafar|Dhu Nafar]],
he says, 'You know, I really want to meet [[Abrahah|Abrahah]]. Do you have any suggestions for me? You have been accompanying this army and these people, you know, for a long time now.
So maybe you have some idea, what can I do to get a face-to-face meeting with [[Abrahah|Abrahah]]?'
And then [[Dhu Nafar|Dhu Nafar]] says, 'You know, I'm just a prisoner, I really can't do anything myself, but I have one idea for you.
I have noticed while I'm traveling with this army
that [[Abrahah|Abrahah]] is very close to
the one who is in charge of the elephant, the elephant trainer.
Remember [[Abrahah|Abrahah]] had an elephant with him, and with that elephant, he had someone who knew how to command the elephant.
They had someone who was experienced in ordering elephants, and this man's name was [[Unays|أنيس]].
So
[[Dhu Nafar|Dhu Nafar]] tells [[Abdul Muttalib|عبد المطلب]] that, 'I noticed that [[Abrahah|Abrahah]] is very close to [[Unays|أنيس]].
[[Abrahah|Abrahah]], he's very close to that elephant trainer [[Unays|أنيس]].
So
if you can get [[Unays|أنيس]] to arrange a meeting between [[Abrahah|Abrahah]] and yourself, I think it will work. And
I can probably talk to [[Unays|أنيس]] about this on your behalf, because during our travels, during our walks, during
this journey that we have gone from [[Yemen|اليمن]] all the way to [[Makkah|Makkah]],
I have also had some conversations with [[Unays|أنيس]],
and you know, we have been able to speak, and he listens to me and we talk sometimes, so maybe
I can talk to [[Unays|أنيس]],
and [[Unays|أنيس]] can talk to [[Abrahah|Abrahah]] to arrange a meeting with you.'
So [[Abdul Muttalib|عبد المطلب]] says, 'Okay, please, please try to do that.'
So [[Dhu Nafar|Dhu Nafar]] says, 'Okay.'
And [[Dhu Nafar|Dhu Nafar]] talks to [[Unays|أنيس]] and he says, 'You know, this leader of these people in this city of [[Makkah|Makkah]],
he wants to have a meeting with [[Abrahah|Abrahah]], so maybe you can talk to [[Abrahah|Abrahah]] and maybe he will agree if you tell him.'
So [[Unays|أنيس]] goes back to [[Abrahah|Abrahah]] and [[Abrahah|Abrahah]] agrees. He says, 'Okay, I'll meet with him.'

So when [[Abdul Muttalib|عبد المطلب]] came to meet [[Abrahah|Abrahah]], [[Abrahah|Abrahah]] was sitting on a throne, on a portable throne that they used to carry with them on their travels. So [[Abrahah|Abrahah]] is sitting up on that throne.
When [[Abdul Muttalib|عبد المطلب]] comes in and [[Abrahah|Abrahah]] sees him for the first time,
he is struck with awe. [[Abdul Muttalib|عبد المطلب]] was a person if you just see him,

you will automatically have reverence and respect for this man. Some people you just see them and you automatically feel a respect for them. So [[Abdul Muttalib|عبد المطلب]] was one of these type of people.
He was very handsome, very good looking, and he just commanded a type of respect
to everyone that just laid eyes on him, they automatically respected him.
So
when he came in the room and [[Abrahah|Abrahah]] saw him,

[[Abrahah|Abrahah]] actually got off of his throne and he sat down on the floor with [[Abdul Muttalib|عبد المطلب]]. He didn't tell [[Abdul Muttalib|عبد المطلب]] to sit down while he stayed on his throne. Out of respect, he actually sat down himself and sat with [[Abdul Muttalib|عبد المطلب]] on the floor.
So then [[Abrahah|Abrahah]] asked him, 'Yes, you wanted to speak to me, what do you want?'
And [[Abdul Muttalib|عبد المطلب]] said, 'You know, when you came into the city,
the people were grazing their camels,
and your army, they confiscated all of those camels, and included in those camels were 200 of my camels. So I just came here to ask you to please give us our camels back, that's it.'
So then [[Abrahah|Abrahah]], he's surprised, because he was expecting something else, and he's also angry.
He felt disrespected by this.

He said, 'You know, when you came into this room, I had respect for you by seeing you, but now you ask me this type of a question? You know I came here to destroy the house that you guys go to to worship Allah.
I came to destroy that house,
and all you can ask me about is your camels?
What is this?'
And then [[Abdul Muttalib|عبد المطلب]] said,

'You know, these camels, they are my camels and my people's camels, this is our responsibility, we are the owners and we have to take care of these things. So that's why I am asking you for this. As for the house that you want to destroy,
that is the house of Allah.'

translit: Inna li-hadha al-bayti rabban yahmih Target Language Meaning: Surely for this House there is a Lord that will protect it.

text: 'Surely for this house, for the house of Allah, there is a Lord that will protect it. I don't need to protect it. You want to go and try to destroy it?
You know, that's not my business. Allah [[Subhanahu wa Ta'ala|سبحانه وتعالى]] is the owner of that house
and he will take care of his house. So I'm not worried about that, I'm just worried about my camels and my people's camels.
So will you release our camels?'
And [[Abrahah|Abrahah]] agrees. He says, 'Okay, I'll release your camels. You can have your camels.'
And then [[Abrahah|Abrahah]] continues to say to [[Abdul Muttalib|عبد المطلب]],
he says, 'You know,
I didn't come here to hurt you or to hurt your people or to kill anyone,
I don't want to harm anyone. I just came here for one purpose: to destroy the [[Ka'bah|كعبة]].

I will destroy the [[Ka'bah|كعبة]] and then I will leave, and you guys can go back to your life, okay? So while I'm here and while we're destroying the [[Ka'bah|كعبة]], I advise you and all the people of [[Makkah|Makkah]], just leave the city, leave [[Makkah|Makkah]] for now, let us do what we want to do,
and then once we leave, come back in, go on with your lives.'
So [[Abdul Muttalib|عبد المطلب]],
he goes out and he orders all of the people of [[Makkah|Makkah]], he says, 'Leave [[Makkah|Makkah]], get out of the city.'
So they all leave the city and they go onto the mountains, you know [[Makkah|Makkah]] is a city that is surrounded by mountains,
